intro: Breton asks you to walk the grounds of Bandarion Keep after the murloc attacks come under control. Meeting the keep’s leader, Danitha Morr, is your first step toward settling among its residents.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.
When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.
I'm very glad to have met you, friend. May the light be your guide.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.
My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.
There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
